Visiaxx

A smartphone eye-testing platform that reached the clinical trial stage. About nine connected apps cover twelve eye tests: a subscription app for users, a B2B app for clinics, sales and home-visit eyewear team apps, a doctor web app for consultations, and an eye camp app. It runs on Android, iOS and web from one Flutter codebase, with Firebase and AWS behind it.
